name: gcc-2.95.2-psx
configKey: Makefile GCC_VERSION; tools/vendor/gcc/<gccVersion> is resolved from it
description: The exact source cc1 is built from, after the old-gcc build recipe's sed and patches. This is the compiler that compiles src/, so it is the authority on every pass-level question.

transforms.note: Run by the Dockerfile under /bin/sh (dash), where ** globs as a single level, so it rewrites */*.c only.

Creates gcc/config/mips/psx.h, whose line 24 sets TARGET_DEFAULT (MASK_GAS+MASK_SOFT_FLOAT+MASK_GPOPT+MASK_SPLIT_ADDR). The 2.95.2-psx recipe applies psx-2.91.patch, NOT psx.patch; cite the applied header, not a patch file.

tree.algorithm: sha256 over LC_ALL=C-sorted lines of '<file sha256>  <path relative to src>\n'

included: src/gcc/*             — every regular file directly under gcc/: the passes, the C front end, the RTL machinery, tm.texi, invoke.texi, and the ChangeLogs
src/gcc/config/mips/* — the whole MIPS backend, including mips.md, mips.c, mips.h and psx.h
src/include/*         — shared headers, including the patched obstack.h
excluded: gcc/cp, gcc/f, gcc/java, gcc/ch, gcc/objc — front ends for other languages; cc1 is not built from them
gcc/config/<97 other targets> — only mips-sony-psx is built
gcc/testsuite, gcc/po, gcc/fixinc, gcc/ginclude, gcc/intl — not compiled into cc1
libio, libstdc++, libf2c, libchill, libobjc, texinfo — runtime libraries and doc tooling
exclusionRisk: A search over this tree is complete for cc1 and incomplete for everything else. compilerSource.ts prints this exclusion list with every result count so an empty result is never read as 'not in GCC'.
